draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains evaluated (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 than Fennick-Base on each.
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold higher than Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The sentence hedges with "may", but the evidence supports an unhedged descriptive claim within the evaluated scope. No statistical test is reported, so significance cannot be claimed.
